reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the QR and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, which is nice, but there is no NSF or USP seal and zero reviews, and I already take a Thorne magnesium that my doctor is fine with. I'm not swapping a brand I trust for an unknown one at $1 a day.
objection: Brand I've never heard of, no reviews, no NSF or USP seal. A lab report behind a QR code is the company's own claim, not a third-party certification I recognize. And my current magnesium works and costs less per serving.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews, or my doctor naming this product.
